findings.detail: The 68-room Thorne collection remains a scale model; article distinguishes overview from lived use, handles, sightlines and drawer movement. No claim that all rooms duplicate specific real homes.
Eastgate is described as architectural inspiration, with thermal mass and mechanical night ventilation; Turner research explicitly counters the termite-mound-air-conditioner myth.
Personal space, privacy and independent operation at home remain distinct from bodily ability, urban heat and artistic music.

Removed possible implication that the tasting arm capability had been reproduced in robotics; now explicitly says researchers learn grasping from octopus. Body already correctly distinguished sensory biology from the soft robot.

Urban heat is about surfaces, shade, retention and everyday public-space use. Plant growth, environmental monitoring and animals retain distinct angles. Rao device is explicitly a development, not a certified universal safety test.

Photography treats framing and personal creative expression; musical Chladni-type plate response is explicitly distinct from arbitrary artistic responses or a diagnosis of synaesthesia. Shared interests and learning/play access remain distinct from general social belonging and physical mobility.
Two small objective corrections: a06 song title equivalence and a07 teaser grammar.
